title: Bubiancraft
description: A "me and the boys restarting our 2-week-phase but slightly modded" experience made into a Vanilla+ modpack.
body:
Bubiancraft is a little modpack composed for Vanilla+ Enthusiasts. Its aim is to enhance player experience in the core components of the original minecraft game identity: Mining / spelunking and world exploration, while combating difficult mobs. Bubiancraft brings all those components back in a revisioned, improved immersion of the tradtional minecraft experience.

Bubiancraft ist ein Modpack für Vanille-Plus-Liebhaber mit Features, welche versuchen, die Spielerfahrung unter Tage massiv zu verbessern. Dunklere Höhlen, tiefere Höhlen, gefährlichere Höhlen, alles dabei, inklusive Bosskämpfe.
